# Research Plan

Owner: **UX Researcher**. Research questions come before method choice, never the reverse — a method shopping for a question produces anecdote dressed as data.

```markdown
# Research Plan: [Study Name]
**Owner**: [UX Researcher]  **Date**: [date]  **Decision deadline**: [when the answer is needed]
**Serves**: [the CEO/PM hypothesis or product decision this study informs]

## 1. Research Questions
What we need to learn, stated BEFORE any method is chosen. 3–5 max, each decision-relevant.
- RQ1: [e.g. Do school admins trust an AI-generated timetable enough to publish it unedited?]
- RQ2: [...]

## 2. Target Segment & Recruitment
**Segment**: [who, tied to the persona / bet canvas]
**Recruitment criteria**: [must-haves, screener questions, exclusions]
**Sample size & rationale**: [n — and why that is enough for THIS decision]
**Known sample bias**: [who this sample over/under-represents — documented, not hidden]
**Consent & privacy**: [how participant data is collected, stored, anonymized]

## 3. Method Matrix
| Method | Answers which RQ | Why this method | Limitations |
|--------|------------------|-----------------|-------------|
| [moderated usability test, n=5] | RQ1 | [observed behavior > stated opinion] | [small n; no longitudinal signal] |

## 4. Protocol Outline
Session structure, key tasks/questions, stimulus shown (prototype / live build),
moderation script link. Pilot the protocol once before real fieldwork.

## 5. Analysis Approach
How raw data becomes findings: [affinity mapping / task success rates / thematic coding].
Findings will distinguish observation, quote, interpretation, and recommendation.

## 6. Confidence & Limitations
**Expected confidence**: High | Medium | Low — given sample and method.
**What this study CANNOT tell us**: [scope limits, stated up front]

## 7. Evidence → Decision Mapping
Agree with the Product Manager BEFORE fieldwork which evidence changes which call.
| If we observe | Then recommend |
|---------------|----------------|
| [4/5 admins manually re-check every generated slot] | [trust-building review UI before any automation push] |
| [no participant completes setup unaided] | [onboarding redesign blocks launch] |
```
